property_summary: For any inputs where _tos and v arrays have equal nonzero length, transfer either completes returning true or reverts, and if it completes then it returns true (i.e., non-reverting calls always return true).
If transfer does not revert for valid inputs (_tos.length>0 and v.length==_tos.length), it returns true.
For any non-empty _tos where v has the same length, transfer either reverts or returns true and never returns false.
